content_of_post_to_answer: Why should we stop trying to force ourselves to be inspired?
answer: Trying to force inspiration often turns creativity into another obligation. The moment you demand that an idea appear, you start judging every thought before it has room to develop. There is also a subtle difference between being uninspired and being unwilling to begin without inspiration. The former is a temporary state; the latter can become a habit. Sometimes inspiration isn't what gets you started. It's what arrives after you've given your attention to something long enough.
